Only include columns whose meanings could reasonably encode that term, such as a full name and short code; omit unrelated columns. Use exact schema identifiers and a case-sensitive verbatim contiguous term from the question. Return only JSON {"output":"requested result","conditions":["verbatim filter cues"],"connective":"AND|OR|single","targets":[{"term":"verbatim literal","candidates":[{"table":"schema table","column":"schema column"}]}]}. Return empty targets unless one explicit filter has at least two plausible columns. Never write SQL.

Schema
CREATE TABLE "car_makers" ("Id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,"Maker" TEXT,"FullName" TEXT,"Country" TEXT,FOREIGN KEY ("Country") REFERENCES "countries"("CountryId"))
CREATE TABLE "car_names" ("MakeId" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,"Model" TEXT,"Make" TEXT,FOREIGN KEY ("Model") REFERENCES "model_list"("Model"))
CREATE TABLE "cars_data" ("Id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,"MPG" TEXT,"cylinder_number" INTEGER,"Edispl" REAL,"Horsepower" TEXT,"Weight" INTEGER,"speed_up" REAL,"Year" INTEGER,FOREIGN KEY ("Id") REFERENCES "car_names"("MakeId"))
CREATE TABLE "continents" ("ContId" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,"Continent" TEXT)
CREATE TABLE "countries" ("CountryId" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,"nation" TEXT,"Continent" INTEGER,FOREIGN KEY ("Continent") REFERENCES "continents"("ContId"))
CREATE TABLE "model_list" ("ModelId" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,"Maker" INTEGER,"Model" TEXT UNIQUE,FOREIGN KEY ("Maker") REFERENCES "car_makers"("Id"))
Question
For a volvo model, how many cylinders does the version with least accelerate have?

output.sql: SELECT T2.cylinder_number FROM model_list AS T1 JOIN car_names AS T2 ON T1.Model = T2.Model JOIN cars_data AS T3 ON T2.MakeId = T3.Id WHERE T1.Maker = (SELECT Id FROM car_makers WHERE Maker = 'volvo') ORDER BY T3.Accelerate ASC LIMIT 1;
